requests.prompt:
Create a completely redesigned v2 fantasy town game background. Input 1 is ONLY painterly style/palette reference, NOT layout or camera. Input 2 warm fine linework material reference only. Deliver an opaque 3840x2160 16:9 game map with NO people, creatures, text, letters, numbers or signage.
Critical camera: LOW oblique orthographic, looking down approximately 30 degrees, NOT isometric 45 degrees. Circular horizontal surfaces must appear as ellipses with height/width 0.50 (allowed .45-.55). Clearly show three measurable circular tops: inn outdoor round table at left middle, open round well near center, round barrel top near forge right middle. Every building has tall front facades and very shallow visible roof depth: facade height below eaves at least TWICE ridge-to-eave screen depth. Shallow roof pitches, long front walls, no huge roofs. No horizon or sky.
Dense inhabited fortified mixed-species town within tall stone castle walls along ALL edges, closed gate on right edge. Joined terraced housing blocks, houses touching neighbors, 2 and 3 storeys and projecting upper floors, many houses backed against castle walls. NO vast empty stone plaza. Connected winding streets around six compact housing blocks; paths min 165px at target size, 35-40% map walkable. Center small well square broken up by stalls and blocks, never an empty 1920x1080 area. Human scale 135px tall adult, doors 160px tall. Keep scale uniform across map.
Six recognizable places IN blocks, all doors facing screen bottom: largest tallest lord manor top CENTER with flags, stone stairs and small tended garden; warm inn left middle with barrels, 2 outdoor round tables and stools; sturdy stone adventurer guild top right-middle with tall windows and sealed blank papers by door; roofed market noticeboard below center with blank papers surrounded by stalls; smoking forge right middle with thick chimney, anvil, water tub, metal ingots and reddish door glow; concealed underground stairs and iron gate at bottom-left alley end, accessible from main streets.
About TEN awning market stalls distributed in a bent street along small central square, showing separate fruit, fish, cloth, potion bottles, tools, leather, dried herbs, flowers. Many lanterns, scales, crates and barrels placed alongside walls NOT blocking street centers.
Mix architecture within each block: mostly human half-timber pale plaster red tiles; 3 distinct elf homes embracing living trees, curving green roofs, vines and raised timber walkway; 6 visibly TINY fairy doors beside human doors only knee high, miniature hanging houses under eaves and flower pots; 3 low thick stone houses with thick chimneys and tools. Several carts, firewood, clotheslines, flowerbeds, trees, stairs and overhead pedestrian bridge. Preserve clear standing pockets at doors, stall fronts, and well, plus room to pass.
Match reference warm delicate ink lines, softly painted clear cel shading, matte stone/wood/textiles, restrained earthy warm palette; quiet low-contrast large paving shapes without noisy cobble grid. Daylight FROM UPPER LEFT, shadows toward LOWER RIGHT. Entire rectangular map filled edge to edge. Detailed high quality actual painted environment, no diagram, no UI, no border.

Edit this exact town background, preserve its warm delicate hand-painted linework, colors, layout of six landmarks and NO people/text. CRITICAL correction: significantly LOWER camera angle to 30-degree orthographic. ALL visible roofs must become VERY SHALLOW short vertical bands: roof visible screen depth no more than one third current depth, while extend each front facade downward/upward to fill former roof area. Rectangular tall plaster/stone walls dominate, NOT tall triangular gables. Flat or gently sloping medieval tile roofs. Every house facade from eave to ground must be at least 2.5 times its visible roof vertical depth; this includes small stone cottages. Retain two/three floors and architectural character. Keep round horizontal tabletops/barrel tops/well rim ellipses height/width exactly .50. WIDEN the entire connected road network by reducing building block footprints by about 15% (not their vertical height): clear usable paths should cover 35-40% of image and always be at least 7.5% of image height wide (equivalent 162 pixels at 2160). Redistribute stalls against building edges and keep ten awnings. Do not create an empty large plaza; broad roads loop around joined dense housing blocks and central well. Most roofs red tile, 3 green elf tree homes, 6 knee-high tiny fairy doors adjacent human doors, 3 low heavy stone homes. Preserve manor at upper center, inn middle-left with outdoor circular tables, guild upper-right, forge middle-right, board below well, hidden underground steps at lower-left. All entrances face bottom. Upper-left sunlight and lower-right shadows. Tall enclosing castle walls and closed right gate. Opaque full-bleed 16:9 landscape target 3840x2160.
